title: Day33 VRRP topology design and dry-run command preview
planned_links: ISP Router / Internet -> WAN-side Switch -> lab01/lab02 WAN
lab01/lab02 LAN bridge -> LAN-side Switch -> Automation PC / Client
notes: This profile matches the intended MikroTik + Cisco Lab Topology v0.2 VRRP dry-run design.
Day33 renders configuration-changing commands as text only: DRY-RUN ONLY and NOT EXECUTED.
Day33 does not connect to routers and does not execute RouterOS commands.
Real device connection information must remain in local private config files and must not be written to the repository.
